report: Read all 13 verses end to end against the 19 candidate groups. No construction is analysed two ways without the ASV licensing the difference.

Suffix thee/thy, לְ to/unto/for/in/against, בְּ, אֶל, כְּ: each English word is the one the ASV wrote for that occurrence; the לְ left unrepresented (79.13 נוֹדֶה לְּךָ → give thee thanks) is rule 40's bare indirect object.

וְ C→Ncmsa: 79.4 לַעַג וָקֶלֶס → scoffing and derision takes the written and; 79.13 דֹר וָדֹר → all generations is rule 22's distributive repetition (first דֹר rendered with the supplied determiner, waw and second דֹר unrepresented). Not a split.
הַ Td→Ncmpa: only the assimilated article of 79.3 כַּמַּיִם → like water goes unrepresented, because the ASV writes no the there; every other article takes a written the (rule 12).

גּוֹי: 79.1 has no article morpheme so the supplied the joins the noun (rule 15); 79.6/79.10 carry an article that takes the written the. שֵׁם: name (79.6, object of בְּ → upon), of name (79.9 rectum), name's (79.9 under לְמַעַן → for … sake). סָבִיב: bare adverb round about (79.3) versus the noun recast as them that are round about (79.4, rule 46). All licensed.

Supplied-word treatment is consistent across the chapter: added only where no morpheme licenses the word (79.3 them after bury, 79.8 our before forefathers); supplied the/a/O and jussive Let frames join the morphemes that license them throughout.

BSB disagreements (6) are all documented conventions, none a genuine error: 79.2 archaic connecting vowel segmented as a suffix with no English; 79.9 עַל and 79.13 לְּ silenced by the ASV's recasting (rule 40); 79.12 lexicalized suffix of אֲדֹנָי (rule 57); 79.13 waw and repeated דֹר of the distributive repetition (rule 22).

Hedged readings already carry their competing analysis in the note (79.5 עַד־מָה split rather than fused; 79.11 בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה split under rule 46 rather than fused; 79.2 to be food kept with the bare accusative under rule 33). Nothing here generalises beyond what the contract already says; no conventions, promotions or amendments.
